title: TOP GEAR OR BLACK MIRROR: INFERRING POLITICAL LEANING FROM NON-POLITICAL CONTENT
reasoning: The paper investigates the use of machine learning to infer political leaning from non-political social media text. Although it utilizes Moral Foundations Theory to interpret its findings and discovers topics related to religion and social values in the dataset, it does not evaluate or benchmark the moral, ethical, or religious reasoning or capabilities of the models themselves.
